name: Mega Financial Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Mega Financial Holding Co., Ltd. provides various financial services in Taiwan. It offers brokerage, dealing and underwriting of short-term debt instruments and financial debentures; notary services for short-term debt instruments and financial debentures; guarantee or endorsement services for short-term debt instruments; brokerage for inter-bank call loans; proprietary trading in government bonds; and foreign and domestic securities brokerage, securities dealing, securities underwriting, and future services.
